title: Clutch Account Opening Data Export record
description: Daily export of deposit/account opening applications, including fraud check, funding and core booking milestones. Derived from the published Clutch data dictionary at https://support.withclutch.com/support/solutions/articles/153000248799-data-exports-account-opening

application_id.description: String: a UUID that represents a unique account opening application.

applicant_id.description: String: a UUID that represents an applicant (not unique — user_id is the unique ID per applicant).

account_nr.description: Number: the account number in core, if an account was created. Null if no account was created.

applicant_name.description: String: applicant's first and last name. Null if the user dropped off before identifying themselves.

applicant_email.description: String: applicant's email address. Null if the user dropped off before identifying themselves.

member_nr.description: Number: the user's member number in core. Null if the user wasn't an existing member and didn't finish the application.

applicant_phone.description: String: applicant's phone number. Null if the user dropped off before identifying themselves.

applicant_address.description: String: applicant's address. Null if the user dropped off before identifying themselves.

applicant_zipCode.description: String: applicant's zip code. Null if the user dropped off before identifying themselves.

applicant_city.description: String: applicant's city. Null if the user dropped off before identifying themselves.

applicant_state.description: String: applicant's state. Null if the user dropped off before identifying themselves.

applicant_employer.description: String: applicant's employer. Null if the user dropped off before identifying themselves.

applicant_job_title.description: String: applicant's job title. Null if the user dropped off before identifying themselves.

eligibility_criteria.description: String: applicant's eligibility criteria for membership. Null if the user dropped off before identifying themselves.

eligibility_detail.description: String: details entered for the applicant's eligibility criteria. Null if the user dropped off before identifying themselves.

product_name.description: String: the account name the user is applying for. Null if the user dropped off before selecting one.

product_type.description: String: account type the user is applying for. Null if the user dropped off before selecting one.

is_new_member.description: Boolean: true if the applicant was an existing member when the application started, false if not.

funding_type.description: String: the funding method the applicant chose:; CREDIT_CARD: credit card; INTERNAL_ACCOUNT: transfer from an existing account at the credit union; ACH: transfer from an existing account at another institution; CASH: cash; LFAO: funding performed by the credit union via internal transfer; NULL: user dropped off before choosing a funding method

funding_amnt.description: Number: amount the user chose to fund the account with.

application_origin.description: String: where the application originated: branch portal or consumer portal.

branch_name.description: String: the name of the branch where the application is sitting.

branch_user_id.description: Number: identifier of the employee responsible for the application.

employee_name.description: String: first and last name of the employee responsible for the application.

application_status.description: String: current status of the application. Possible values:; ACCEPTED: the application was successful and an account has been opened; INITIATED: the application started and is still in progress; FRAUD_VERIFICATION: the fraud management review is in progress; DENIED: the application wasn't allowed to proceed; CANCELLED: the application started but didn't continue; ERROR: the application had an issue; EXTERNAL_FUNDING_CONFIRMATION: waiting for funding confirmation; LOAN_FIRST_DRAFT: a non-member submitted a loan application but an employee hasn't triggered account opening yet

account_status.description: String: current status of the account. Possible values:; CREATED: the account has been opened; CANCELLED: the application was cancelled before an account was created; PENDING: the account opening process is still in progress

funding_status.description: String: current status of the funding. Possible values:; COMPLETED: the account has been funded; CANCELLED_OR_REFUNDED: the application was cancelled before an account was created; CREATED / INITIATED / PENDING: funding is still in progress; ERROR: a funding issue occurred

application_created_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the application started.

account_created_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the account was created. Deprecated — use account_booked_to_core_at instead.

application_updated_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when this record was last updated.

received_AAN.description: Boolean: true if the applicant received an Adverse Action Notice, false if not.

aan_created_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the Adverse Action Notice was sent.

aan_reason.description: String: reason(s) the applicant received an Adverse Action Notice.

utm_source.description: String: part of the URL used for tracking (must be present in the Clutch URL).

utm_medium.description: String: part of the URL used for tracking (must be present in the Clutch URL).

utm_campaign.description: String: part of the URL used for tracking (must be present in the Clutch URL).

utm_content.description: String: part of the URL used for tracking (must be present in the Clutch URL).

utm_term.description: String: part of the URL used for tracking (must be present in the Clutch URL).

funding_started_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the user chose a funding method (null if they didn't).

funding_authorized_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the user's funding was authorized (null if it wasn't).

fraud_check_approved_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the user was approved by the integrated fraud check flow (null if not applicable).

account_booked_to_core_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the user's account was booked to core (null if not applicable).

user_id.description: String: a UUID that represents a unique applicant.

session_id.description: String: an ID representing a unique user session. A session lasts up to 4 hours, or ends after 15 minutes of inactivity.

extra_fee.description: Number: the extra fee applied, if any. Can be null.

accepted_tcpa_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when TCPA was accepted (null if it wasn't).

fraud_check_entity_token.description: String: an identifier for the fraud check token. Can be null.

account_id.description: String: a UUID that represents a unique account.

handoff_type.description: String: how the handoff for in-branch applications happened. Possible values: DIGITAL or NON_DIGITAL.

consent_type.description: String: how consent for account opening was given. Possible values: DIGITAL_CONSENT (applicant clicked in the experience) or MANUAL_CONSENT (applicant gave consent to the employee assisting them).

account_features.description: Array: list of features the applicant added to the account.

fraud_check_status.description: String: most up-to-date fraud check status. Possible values:; APPROVED; DENIED; PENDING_USER_ACTION; REFER; ERROR

fraud_check_application_id.description: String: an identifier for the fraud check application. Can be null.

promo_code.description: String: promotional code entered during the application for special offers.

had_manual_review.description: Boolean: whether a human had to intervene or manually review the application.

had_step_up.description: Boolean: whether the user saw a step-up screen during the fraud check flow.

fraud_check_started_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the fraud check was started.

fraud_check_decision_made_at.description: Timestamp: date and time when the fraud check was completed (application approved or declined).

device_id.description: String: unique identifier for the device used to start the application session.

authentication_method.description: String: the method used to authenticate the session that created the application. Possible values: sso, password.

referral_code.description: String: referral code entered during the application (e.g., member-get-member or employee referral program). Null if no referral code was used.

fraud_check_tags.description: String: fraud check tags associated with the application, returned as a semicolon-separated string. Null if no tags were returned.
